name: 404servernotfound
description:
404 // SERVER NOT FOUND – Faction PvP with 1.8 PvP (old combat, no attack cooldown). Java & Bedrock cross-play.

Claim land, build your base, form alliances and raid the rest. Raiding is allowed – claims stop building, not attacks.

Events: world bosses with telegraphed attacks, supply drops, King of the Hill and a vote party every 25 votes.

Economy: shop, player market, safe trading, daily quests, daily rewards and crates.

Easy start: one-time starter kit, newbie protection and a command hall below spawn.

English & German community – the game follows your language.

Java: play.404servernotfound.net · Bedrock: play.404servernotfound.net port 19132

Discord: discord.gg/HpeHGy2aDd
